title: settings
subtitle: configure app preferences
themeSubtitle: choose the look of the interface
currencySubtitle: display amounts in your preferred currency using live exchange rates
projectionsSubtitle: choose the pay schedule and date range for projections
addScheduleFirstPrefix: > add an income pay schedule on
projectionStartDateHint: > projections and account balances start on this date; earlier income and expenses are ignored. until the next pay date only your starting balance applies (no salary). to start over, set it to today and enter your current account balances
projectionEndDateHint: > optional; leave empty for a rolling 12-month horizon. the full pay period containing this date is included. maximum: 2 years from today
initialBalanceFromAccounts: > the projection's opening balance is the total of your account starting amounts — manage them in
extraSpentSubtitle: optimal limit for unplanned spending (expenses not tied to recurring, planned, or budgets)
extraSpentHint: > leave empty to remove the limit
